csv_project_name: AE for McGregor Comprehensive Plan & Development Codes
csv_scope_of_work: The City of McGregor (hereafter City ) is seeking to enter into an agreement with a qualified Individual Firm, or Corporation, (hereafter Respondent, ) to assist the City in the creation of a new Comprehensive Plan and to update development codes to reflect the new vision of the plan. The goal is to develop a comprehensive plan as an effective tool to manage future development. Preference will be given to the firm which has demonstrated capabilities in successfully completing projects of similar scope and complexity and routinely exceeds expectations in terms of work product quality and project delivery. In coordination with the City, the Respondent shall develop a Comprehensive Plan that must include, at a minimum, the following elements: Public Involvement Plan Public input is the basis of good planning and should be incorporated into every planning component. A plan for obtaining the input of key stakeholder groups and the general public that maximizes the stakeholder input within a short timeframe. Consideration should be given to ongoing public input processes and the potential for serving multiple public input purposes beyond the duration of the Comprehensive Plan process. Baseline Analysis Assessment of Census data of population, housing, and economics. Assessment of existing land uses. Assessment of jurisdictions, service areas, and other administrative boundaries. Assessment of available studies, reports, GIS data, etc. Assessment of areas of known natural hazards. Economic Development Plan Narrative describing trends in economic development, with a specific focus on regional trends and downtown redevelopment. Identify existing programs of partner entities and make recommendations on policy and program areas for shared investment. Plans for the redevelopment of the aging stock of existing commercial properties along major thoroughfares. Land Use Quantitative analysis and narrative describing trends in land use. Population study providing an estimate of the current population and a projection for population increase over the next 20 years. Future Land Use Plan to include goals, policies, programs, and actions as well as maps, tables, and charts in support thereof. Housing Narrative describing trends in housing and analysis of the existing housing options within the city. Provide recommendations for maintaining the viability of the existing housing stock and providing housing choices for the future. Provide projections for the number of future housing units needed to accommodate the population growth, including the composition of said units (e.g., single-family, multifamily). Infrastructure & Facilities Maps of the existing infrastructure within the network of the City: o Roadways (thoroughfares) including traffic count data where available; o Water/wastewater network, storage and treatment capacities and maintenance responsibility o Public safety jurisdictions and facilities. o Park and trail facilities. Set of goals, policies, programs, and actions designed to prioritize improvements to those systems. Develop maps, tables, and charts in support of the analysis and recommendations. Narrative describing policies for infrastructure development and maintenance between existing and new developments of infrastructure. Narrative shall include goals, policies, programs, or actions. Implementation The Plan must be implementation oriented. It must include actionable strategies, measurable objectives, and realistic timelines that align with the city s capacity and available resources. The plan must include specific recommendations for immediate updates to zoning and subdivision regulations.

title: AE for McGregor Comprehensive Plan & Development Codes
short_description: Comprehensive plan and development code update for the City of McGregor.
project_scope: Preparation of a new comprehensive plan and updated development codes for the City of McGregor. Scope includes a public involvement plan; baseline analysis of census, housing, economics, land use, jurisdictions, service areas, administrative boundaries, studies, GIS data, and natural hazards; economic development strategy with regional trends, downtown redevelopment, and commercial corridor revitalization; land use analysis with 20-year population projections and future land use plan; housing analysis and future housing unit projections; infrastructure and facilities assessment covering roadways, traffic counts, water and wastewater networks, storage and treatment capacities, public safety facilities, parks, and trails; and implementation measures including zoning and subdivision regulation updates.
services: Planning and master planning services; land use planning; urban studies/planning/design; housing and urban development; GIS/mapping support; traffic and transportation planning studies; civil, sanitation, stormwater, and wastewater-related planning inputs.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure comprehensive planning and development code update, not a structural or building project.
- Focus is urban planning, land use, housing, infrastructure policy, and public involvement.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural design component.
- Falls under project types to reject: pure urban/open space planning, landscape, urban design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The procurement is for planning and code update services only, with no defined construction project or capital works budget in the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a planning consultancy for a comprehensive plan and code update, no realistic sbp engineering fee can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Qualified individual, firm, or corporation with demonstrated capability in successfully completing projects of similar scope and complexity and routinely exceeding expectations in work product quality and project delivery.
award_criteria: Preference will be given to the firm demonstrating capabilities and successful completion of similar projects of comparable scope and complexity; no detailed weighting stated.
contracting_authority: City of McGregor, McGregor, TX, USA. Contact: Bryan LeMeilleur. Phone: 254-456-9308. Fax: 254-840-4377. Email: blemeilleur@mcgregortx.gov. Website: https://cityofmcgregor.com/comprehensive-land-use/
notes: Although the target market is listed as General Building, the actual scope is a municipal comprehensive plan and development code update rather than a building or structural project. Funding noted as RCP. Source lists Agency as McGregor ISD, but the scope and contact clearly refer to the City of McGregor.
